prompts.oduck: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an isolated wearable equipment sprite sheet for the ORIGINAL tiny yellow duck Oduck, reference image 1 shows its exact body proportions and side-facing-left poses. Do not redraw the duck. Output ONLY FOUR separate fitted sailor-vest garment overlays on genuine transparency, equal four-column single-row layout. Classic MapleStory CASH PET pixel art, coarse crisp block pixels, 1 logical pixel dark outlines, solid clustered palette, no gradients/soft glow. All four designs same compact navy sleeveless vest with narrow cream sailor collar, tiny cream front panel at the LEFT chest, subtle one-pixel coral-red seam; rounded navy fabric wrapping the RIGHT back, cut-out at RIGHT wing root so yellow wing remains exposed. This is clothing for an extremely SMALL horizontal oval duck torso about 16 pixels wide by 9 pixels high below an enormous head. Not a human jacket, NO sleeves/large lapels/wide collar/large badge. Garment must NOT hang over its beak, head, feet, tail or drink. The collar is under the head at the upper-right neck of torso. Views in order: 1 standing left-facing 3/4 torso 16x9 pixels; 2 same side view torso tilted forward slightly walking 16x9; 3 sitting/eating compressed oval torso 16x7; 4 lying asleep sideways, only curved back fabric visible behind huge head 8x5. Show the wing opening clearly on the RIGHT side of each clothing overlay. Do not draw duck skin, animal body, mannequin, props, shadows or backgrounds. The attached sheet is style and anatomy reference only. Make geometry simple and legible at tiny native resolution, essentially 16x9 logical pixels per garment magnified evenly. Keep all items completely inside their cells and no text.

No dangling fabric/sleeves; do not cover original muzzle, paws or striped tail. Design so existing pale checked coat is mostly covered when worn. The same vest in FOUR perspectives: 1 broad front-left idle 19x8, 2 same walking with slight forward tilt 19x8, 3 bent forward eating 20x7, 4 curled resting side view 13x6 with collar mostly hidden. Saturated muted forest-teal fabric, warm cream seams, no small noisy detail, no oversized collar; smooth rounded garment silhouette made with crisp logical pixels. Only garments on real transparency, no animal fur/body/mannequin/shadow/ground, no labels. Keep all items centered within equal four cells and match proportion of tiny torso in reference.

prompts.ducky: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference original golden fennec fox Ducky pet, NOT a dog with human chest. Create ONLY FOUR isolated fitted rose-plum pet bolero clothing pieces, a four-column single-row sprite sheet on real transparency. Classic MapleStory tiny CASH PET pixel art matching reference, crisp chunky logical pixels, fixed palette, dark brown thin outline, no smooth gradients, glow, text. The fennec has a huge head, cream jaw/chest ruff, tiny short torso, FOUR paws, big upright ears and fluffy tail. Make a rich plum rounded sleeveless short vest with a very narrow cream seam, small pale rose front band, no sleeves or large lapels. Designed for about 13 pixels wide and 7 pixels high actual torso. LEFT front cream chest partially visible, right back plum covers torso; the sleeve openings are cut-outs for original front/back legs, coat hem above paws and before tail. Do not cover the cream jaw. Four perspectives: 1 side-left slightly three-quarter standing 13x7; 2 left-facing walking horizontal back 14x7; 3 lowered head eating squat torso 14x5; 4 curled asleep sideview, mostly short curved back cape visible 10x5. Show only equipment with open transparent neck/paw holes, no fox head/fur/skin/body/tail/paws/mannequin. All same garment/palette. Native tiny pet proportions, no tall human vest. Everything completely within own cell, no words.
prompts.bugi: Use case: stylized-concept. Image1 original Bugi Land Turtle is anatomy and pixel style reference only. MapleStory CASH PET sprite style: crisp chunky logical pixels, thin dark brown edge, warm cream piping, 4 to 6 flat shades, no gradients, blur, glow, words. The turtle has huge bald cream head and a domed orange shell; shawl must COVER AND WRAP THE DOME OF THE SHELL like a rounded half-oval cap, with a small open front strap at LEFT neck edge; it is not a tiny square decal on the shell, not a human jacket, and do not draw a turtle or actual orange shell. Torso shell native target about 17x12 pixels. Curve rises on left/top and falls toward RIGHT rear; thin cream hem and tiny golden clasp. Use dark green with a leaf-green highlight area for visibility on orange shell. Shell lip and feet stay unobstructed below. Four views: 1 left-facing sideview rounded 17x12 shell drape; 2 same gentle forward walking dome 17x12; 3 eating lowered head, higher shell shoulder cloak 17x12; 4 resting sideways compressed dome 17x9. Open/transparent hole for neck in left bottom; no turtle head, orange shell, skin, paws or animal body pixels, only wearable green fabric. Four same design and color. Each wholly within its equal cell.
prompts.accessories: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent MapleStory cash-pet ACCESSORY sprite sheet with exactly EIGHT separate pieces, 2 rows by 4 columns, equally spaced. Only wearable accessories, no pets/bodies/text/mannequins/shadows. Native tiny pixel art: crisp coarse pixel blocks, dark one-logical-pixel outlines, a few solid color clusters, no blur or gradients. This will be used on tiny pets, so every FLOWER/BELL/CHARM should be large enough to recognize, not thin indistinct crumbs. ROW1 head ornaments, each about 14 logical pixels wide and 10 pixels tall, front-left slightly 3/4 readable view: column1 Guri dog: two compact green leaves beside one big cream daisy with a bold golden round center, daisy fills half the accessory, not a long twig; column2 Ducky fox: rich rose pink bow with pale cream seam and one round gold bell hanging at center, compact symmetric bow; column3 Bugi turtle: two vibrant leafy sprouts and a round cream flower with amber center, compact low shape, no long stems; column4 Oduck duck: aqua bow with a large coral star centered, compact bow, star fills half. ROW2 NECKLACES: each about 14 logical pixels wide and 7 pixels tall, visible FRONT HALF of shallow curved brown collar with one oversized central pendant filling about 5x5 logical pixels. Upper rear arc MUST be absent/transparent, neckline shallow, pendant centered LOWER MIDDLE, not sideways/dangling off edge. column1 bronze-gold round AMBER medallion with cream glint; column2 vivid turquoise TEARDROP gem with cream glint; column3 vivid SKY BLUE round jewel with cream glint; column4 vivid MINT GREEN STAR with cream glint. Thin short brown collar spans horizontally behind pendant. Every item stays entirely inside its cell, isolated genuinely transparent background, no extra objects. These are independently removable pixel pet gear layers and must look clear at 14x10 and 14x7, not detailed high resolution ornaments.
